static_traits.name: He Wenda
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no similar psychological problems before; have not received psychotherapy in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly good logic; able to notice my own thought patterns (self-labeling, overgeneralization, personalization); Reserved and skeptical about change but willing to try; tending to 'shut down' and procrastinate under stress and unclear tasks

basic_info.main_problem: After using marijuana, I especially feel lazy and unmotivated, and often label myself a 'degenerate addict' because of these feelings.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because I noticed these feelings of laziness significantly affect my work performance and daily life.

core_beliefs: I am unable to handle my responsibilities

special_situations.event: On the day of or several times a week after using marijuana, experiences laziness and low motivation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot complete tasks efficiently after smoking marijuana, it proves I am a lazy, degenerate person
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to reduce intake and set strict schedules to prove I am not lazy
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Once I smoke I become lazy; I cannot get things done

special_situations.event: When facing work deadlines, stress rises, with procrastination and difficulty getting started
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot complete tasks on time with high quality, it means I am incompetent and lazy
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Temporarily lowering Anxiety through Procrastination and avoidance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am going to mess up again; I will not finish this time either

special_situations.event: Strained colleague relationships due to declining output
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If relationships are tense then It is all my problem, meaning I am terrible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-blame, labeling oneself, reducing interaction to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I let them down,It is all my fault

special_situations.event: Feeling overwhelmed and 'shutting down' when Tasks vague or too overwhelming
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If goals are unclear I cannot start, meaning I Lack motivation and ability
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stops action, waits for the task to become clearer or more manageable
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Things are too messy and too many; I cannot do it

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be seen as capable, able to maintain control and motivation over work and life
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being labeled 'lazy/loser', unable to handle duties, negated by colleagues
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of control and self-esteem through controlling behaviors (reducing cannabis, setting strict schedules)
Temporarily evades stress and judgment through procrastination and self-blame

object_relations.object_representation: Critical and disappointed colleagues (who evaluate and negate me)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes cognitive restructuring or suggests behavioral experiments and setting small goals
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing changing thoughts is very hard, doubting these methods work for me (seeing myself as a fixed 'lazy person')
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use a supportive, exploratory tone; first validate the client's doubts and hard work, then use open questions to invite them to recall exception moments and concrete situations; assist in breaking down tasks and setting tiny achievable goals; avoid confrontation and labeling, and replace abstract judgments with concrete language.

manifestations: Persistent low motivation and laziness, work and daily life lack vitality
The self is defined and limited by a negative label ('decadent addict')
Shutdown and procrastination occur when tasks are ambiguous or pressure is high

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequently using self-deprecating labels to define myself
Skeptical attitude toward change, worrying methods will be ineffective
Self-shutting-down and procrastinating when tasks are unclear and stress is high
Tending to blame Decreased motivation on myself and restricting action

exception_events.target_problem: After smoking marijuana or Facing work deadlines, the client usually procrastinates and struggles to complete tasks, causing Decline in work performance.
exception_events.unique_outcome: On a few days when stress was lower, tasks were clear, and substance use was less, the client was able to focus and stay productive, completing concrete, manageable tasks.
exception_events.reason: Clues: due to lower stress, clear and manageable tasks, set clear goals and reduced intake, this time there was no usual procrastination; able to engage and complete tasks.

positive_force: Willing to try structured small goals and behavioral experiments
Able to notice the patterns affecting motivation (stress, task clarity, amount smoked)
Has available social support (one close friend)
Has had efficient moments before, proving the ability to be competent and engaged
negative_force: Overwhelmed by high Work stress and unclear tasks
Marijuana use and social-circle influence driving Decreased motivation
Habitual coping of short-term Anxiety relief through procrastination/avoidance
Skeptical attitude toward change, reduces trying and persisting

target_behavior.behavior: Shows procrastination and low motivation after using cannabis and in high-pressure work situations, with difficulty starting tasks
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalizing the 'lazy/helpless' self-label, engaging in emotional reasoning under stress and unclear tasks; marijuana effects combined with high stress and unclear tasks, lowering Self-efficacy and initiation ability
target_behavior.function: Short-term escaping high pressure and failure feelings, lowering Anxiety and shame experiences
target_behavior.consequence: Work performance damaged; Tense relationships with colleagues; daily self-care and housework affected
